# WE5 · Dịch vụ

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · page · Next.js: **planned (U4)** (`/services`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#services`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `operations-ui.js › services()`: service cards (price, duration, buffer, rooms, active) with "Chỉnh dịch vụ".
- Page key `services` is allowed for roles: owner (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"services\"]"}; it must show `[data-ops="service"]`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/services` · status: **planned (U4)** · U step: U4
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: none yet (the step that builds the page appends it)
- Existing page file: — (planned)

## Responsive
- 1440×900 is the reference (Frame, Layout).
- 1920×1020: .service-grid: grid 2 → 4 columns
- 1280×720: no layout change
- 1024×768: .sidebar: width 232 → 204px
- 390×844: .page-heading: display flex → block; .service-grid: grid 2 → 1 columns; .sidebar: position fixed → static; .sidebar: width 232 → 390px; .topbar: position sticky → static · hidden: "PHÒNG KHÁM DA LIỄU", "Không gian làm việc", "Quản lý", "Phân tích", "BT", "BS. Tâm", "Chủ phòng khám", "Không gian phòng khám" (+1)

## Differences from the app design
- App F13 shows the same four services read-only with "300.000 ₫ · 30 phút"; the web can edit them (owner).

## Gotchas
- The 4th card is drawn as "Tạm ngưng" (status-yellow) so that both statuses of the old web appear; in the old demo all four are "Đang dùng". Each old card has its own tint per service (S0–S3); the canvas card has no tint (open item: card variant per service colour).
